issues.quote: R&D expense increased to $24.5 billion in fiscal 2022 from $19.3 billion in fiscal 2021.
issues.problem: Microsoft's FY2021 R&D expense was about $20.7 billion; $19.3 billion was the FY2020 figure. This overstates R&D growth (about 18%, not about 27%).

data.summary: Revenue, gross profit, operating income, net income, EPS and both margins match Microsoft's reported FY2022 results. The FY2021 R&D figure is wrong: it is the FY2020 number.
